Quitline Terms of Use

Effective October 8, 2026 · Last updated October 8, 2026

In plain English: your use of Quitline is governed by Apple's standard app license, plus the extra terms below. Quitline is a self-help tool, not medical treatment or a crisis service. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel, and a free trial turns into a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.

If you are in crisis or in danger, call your local emergency number. In the US or Canada, call or text 988. Elsewhere, see findahelpline.com. More resources: Quitline Support.

Apple's Standard EULA

Quitline is licensed to you, not sold, under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (the "Standard EULA"). The Standard EULA, including its sections on the scope of the license, consent to use of data, termination, warranty disclaimers, limitation of liability, export rules and governing law, applies to Quitline. These Terms of Use add app-specific terms. If these terms and the Standard EULA conflict, the Standard EULA controls, except where these terms give you more rights. TixPanda, not Apple, is responsible for Quitline and its support. Apple is a third-party beneficiary of the Standard EULA and may enforce it.

By downloading or using Quitline you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the app. Our Privacy Policy explains how data is handled.

Not medical advice

  • Quitline is a general self-help, education and tracking tool for people who want to stop or cut down vaping, smoking, gambling, drinking or social media use. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition.
  • Lessons, health and recovery timelines, money estimates and insights are general information. They are not personal medical, psychological, financial or legal advice, and individual results vary. Sources are cited in the app where relevant.
  • Talk to a qualified healthcare professional before quitting or changing your use of a substance if you have a medical condition, are pregnant, take medication, or are considering nicotine replacement or other medicines. Stopping heavy daily drinking suddenly can be dangerous; talk to a doctor first.
  • Quitline is not a crisis or emergency service and nobody monitors what you enter. Crisis lines listed in the app are independent services; TixPanda is not affiliated with them and is not responsible for their services.
  • Quitline is an independent app and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any government or public quitline service.

Using Quitline

Quitline is meant for people aged 13 and older. If you are under the age of majority where you live, use it with the permission of a parent or guardian, who also agrees to these terms for purchases. Features may differ between versions and may change as we improve the app.

Free version and ads

The essential tools (including the panic button, breathing, urge surfing and crisis help) are free. The free version shows ads served by third-party ad networks through AppLovin MAX; ads are never shown on the panic, breathing, urge-surfing or crisis-help screens. We are not responsible for the content of third-party ads or the websites or apps they link to, although we ask our ad partners to block ads for alcohol, tobacco and vaping products, and gambling, where their controls allow it. Rewarded ads may unlock a small bonus described in the app; rewards have no cash value, cannot be transferred and may change.

Quitline Pro: subscriptions, free trial and lifetime purchase

The free version of Quitline includes ads and the features described in the app as free. Quitline Pro unlocks the Pro features and removes ads. Pro is available as:

  • An auto-renewing subscription (yearly, and any other period offered in the app). The yearly plan may include a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, as an Apple introductory offer.
  • A lifetime purchase: a one-time, non-consumable purchase. No renewals.

The price, billing period and trial length are shown in the app before you confirm and in Apple's purchase sheet. Prices vary by country and may include taxes.

How billing works

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. If you start a free trial, you are not charged during the trial; your Apple ID is charged the subscription price when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends, at the then-current price.
  • You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time in iOS Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or from the "Manage subscription" option in the app's Settings. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. If you cancel during a free trial, Apple may end your access to Pro right away.
  • Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription or the lifetime purchase.
  • If a price increases, Apple notifies you in advance and, where required, asks for your consent before renewing at the new price.
  • If you have a subscription and later buy the lifetime purchase, cancel the subscription in Settings so you are not charged twice. The app reminds you.
  • Purchases are shareable with up to five other family members through Apple's Family Sharing, where the app says so.

Refunds and restores

All payments are processed by Apple. TixPanda cannot see or issue refunds; request one from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple's refund decisions and your statutory rights (for example, EU/UK withdrawal rights for digital content) are handled by Apple under its terms. Use "Restore Purchases" in the app to get Pro back on a new device signed in to the same Apple ID.

Your data

What you enter stays on your device (and your own iCloud, if you turn on sync). You are responsible for keeping your device, Apple ID and any exported files secure, and for keeping backups. TixPanda cannot recover data you delete or lose because we never have a copy.

Acceptable use

Don't use Quitline to break the law or anyone else's rights; don't send partner codes or share cards to harass anyone; don't try to reverse-engineer, tamper with or bypass the app's purchase checks or ad systems, except where the law allows this despite this restriction; and don't use automated means to generate fake ad impressions or rewards.

Disclaimers and liability

Quitline is provided "as is" and "as available", as described in the Standard EULA. We do not promise that using Quitline will help you quit or achieve any health result. To the extent the law allows, TixPanda is not liable for decisions you make based on the app's content, for missed notifications or reminders, or for the loss of data stored on your device or iCloud, and our total liability is limited as described in the Standard EULA. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or rights you have under consumer law in your country that cannot be waived.

Changes

We may update these terms, for example when we add features. We will change the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app. Continuing to use Quitline after a change means you accept the updated terms. Changes never apply retroactively to purchases you already made.
